title: Battle of Villersexel
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Villersexel", at revision 1370592550, opens: "The Battle of Villersexel took place on 9 January 1871 as part of the Franco-Prussian War. Elements of the French Armée de l'Est under General Bourbaki engaged August von Werder's German forces. It resulted in a French victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q551432, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1871 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
